humanAsset.displayScope: Raw native output; this harness does not reproduce the old demo's adaptive exposure or legacy fast-bloom U2 tone curve.
humanAsset.eyePolicy: Pinned scan has genuine overlapping eye UV charts. Every ambiguous four-load footprint keeps screen diffuse; head UV transport remains active. No anatomical mask or source-byte rewrite is invented.
humanAsset.normalPolicy: Generated smooth mesh normals remain separate from the original linear NoSmoothUV object-normal map. Explicit (1,1,-1) input signs match importer MakeLeftHanded; no extra UV/normalY flip.

surfaceMeasurementProjection.scope: CPU projection/nearest-surface classification of actual imported triangles; no image is synthesized and all radiometry is read from actual GPU/PNG outputs

transmissionControl.scope: Same Gaussian and UV capture; only measured front-entry transmission is toggled.

subsurface-human_report.validationScope: Caller collects actual Vulkan/Metal/DX12 messages. This harness creates no replacement renderer; readbacks/capture/CPU surface classification are outside frame timing.
